request: One of the long edges of the blade does not have a radius. Add radius to that long edge R=0,635cm

actions.operation: Add edge fillet (constant radius) to an existing edge
actions.target: One long edge of the blade (the long edge currently without a radius)
actions.relational_constraint: Apply the fillet along that long edge
actions.unresolved_reference: The multiview images show long members with a long longitudinal sharp break/edge where a flat clearance face meets an outer surface. The model has multiple long candidate edges (e.g., both sides of the diagonal member’s longitudinal flat). Confirm which specific long edge is intended (e.g., the upper vs lower edge of the diagonal member’s longitudinal flat near the clamp), and whether the fillet should include the entire tangency chain or be bounded only between the clamp-trim end limits.
steps: Identify the most likely ‘blade’ long edge in this 3-solid assembly: on the Diagonal tubular member (Section S1), the long sharp edge is created by the intersection of the Longitudinal flat/trim plane (face_code 0006) with the Outer OD cylinder along the tube length (face_code 0002; and its adjacent OD patches face_code 0001 and 0003 near the clamp trimming). This produces a long, straight edge line running along the member and visually reads as a ‘blade edge’ in the multiviews (notably top/bottom views).
Activate the Diagonal tubular member solid (S1) for editing, and start the Fillet/Edge Round feature (constant radius).

Edge selection (localization): select the long edge formed by the intersection of face_code 0006 (Longitudinal flat/trim plane) with the OD cylindrical faces (face_code 0002, including continuation across face_code 0001 and 0003 if the cylinder is split by clamp-related trimming). Use tangent-propagation/edge-chain selection so the fillet runs continuously along the full intended length of that long edge.
Set fillet radius = 0.635 cm (6.35 mm). Use a constant-radius fillet.

Define fillet extent/limits: bound the fillet to stop at the natural termination points where the long edge ends due to existing trim features in the clamp engagement region (near face_code 0007 and 0008 ‘Clamp-intersection planes’ and/or other local trim faces), and/or at the end conditions where the longitudinal flat terminates before the tube end faces. Do not roll the fillet onto unrelated local notch/saddle surfaces unless explicitly required.

Regenerate and validate geometry: confirm the fillet does not self-intersect given the diagonal tube OD radius (~6.35 mm) and does not create unwanted interference with the Central clamp / block body (S3) in the crossing region. If tangent propagation causes the fillet to extend into the saddle/blend region (faces 0014/0016/0017/0019) and fails, disable propagation at that boundary and apply only along the straight long edge segment(s) associated with face_code 0006 ↔ OD faces (0002/0001/0003).

Visual check in top/bottom and isometric views: verify that the previously sharp ‘missing radius’ long edge now appears rounded consistently along its length, matching the intended design language (removing the single sharp long edge while leaving other functional clamp-contact/clearance faces unchanged).

intention: Add the missing radius/fillet to the blade’s long edge that currently has no radius.
